# Program

> Our political program for structural transformation.

Source: https://die-zukunft.ch/en/program/ · Publisher: The Future (Swiss political party, Basel)

### [Sovereign AI & Compute](https://die-zukunft.ch/en/sovereign-ai/)

Compute is the infrastructure of the 21st century. Our own AI capacity, open Swiss models like Apertus and the ability to audit and operate AI ourselves. Accessible to universities, SMEs and public administration.

### [Digital Sovereignty](https://die-zukunft.ch/en/digital-sovereignty/)

Critical digital systems must remain under democratic control. Swiss/EU-first for critical infrastructure and sensitive data. Anti-lock-in, open source, supply-chain security.

### [Re-industrialisation with Robotics](https://die-zukunft.ch/en/robotics/)

More production and value creation in Switzerland — robust, modern, automated. SME-friendly with financing, shared labs and faster procedures.

### [Work Without Fear](https://die-zukunft.ch/en/transitions/)

Retraining, professional mobility and transition support as the norm — not only in crisis. Fewer hurdles, better recognition, modular education.

### [Life Science & Health](https://die-zukunft.ch/en/life-science/)

Enabling progress — without losing control. Health data opt-in, evidence-based regulation, no black-box state medicine.

### [Basic Income](https://die-zukunft.ch/en/basic-income/)

Reducing existential fear, lowering bureaucracy, enabling entrepreneurship. A federal pilot with independent evaluation.

### [Cities & Housing](https://die-zukunft.ch/en/urban-housing/)

Affordable housing and high quality of life — through densification where infrastructure exists, and less sprawl in the periphery. More building rights at transit hubs, fast-track permits, minimum densities.

### [Research, Innovation & Commons](https://die-zukunft.ch/en/research-innovation/)

Switzerland should be the place where serious innovation can be built, tested and responsibly scaled fastest — with clear public benefit and European compatibility.

### [Energy & Infrastructure Resilience](https://die-zukunft.ch/en/energy-resilience/)

Reliable supply, robust infrastructure and predictable costs — as the foundation for prosperity, comfort and sovereignty. Resilience is engineering: clear standards, clear responsibilities, clear redundancies.

### [Open Government](https://die-zukunft.ch/en/open-government/)

A state that enables rather than blocks: transparent by law, API-by-default and open procedures. Offices filled on competence rather than party membership, term limits, all interests declared — so citizens can scrutinise the state and build better tools.

### [Neutrality & Peace](https://die-zukunft.ch/en/neutrality-peace/)

Switzerland remains neutral, sovereign and credible — and once again becomes a place where peace is negotiated. Strictly defensive, good offices, diplomacy and humanitarian strength.

### [Talent, Integration & Rule of Law](https://die-zukunft.ch/en/talent-integration/)

Switzerland should be a magnet for people who want to build something — and at the same time remain a country where security, order and trust are self-evident.

### [Language & Understanding](https://die-zukunft.ch/en/language-understanding/)

Switzerland should become the European model for understanding: more shared communication in everyday life and business — without displacing national languages.

## Our program for transformation

Our program addresses the central challenges of structural change — pragmatic, measurable and tailored to Swiss conditions.
